import collections,hashlib,json,os,re,subprocess,sys,time
from pathlib import Path
root=Path(Path('/tmp/tsr-this-admission-path').read_text().strip())
triple=json.loads((root/'binary-triple.json').read_text()); newer=json.loads((root/'contextual-binary.json').read_text()); triple['builds'].extend(newer['builds'])
diagnostic=sys.argv[1]=='diagnostics';kind='diagverdictdump' if diagnostic else 'verdictdump'
suffix='diagnostics' if diagnostic else 'types';sha=lambda b:hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
assert [r['mode'] for r in triple['builds']]==['candidate','entry','baseline','contextual']
def parsed(raw):
    text=raw.decode();pattern=r'(?m)^[^\t\r\n]+\t(?:RIGHT|WRONG|EMPTY_RIGHT|EMPTY_WRONG)\t' if diagnostic else r'(?m)^[^\t\r\n]+:\d+:\d+\t(?:RIGHT|GAP|WRONG)\t'
    starts=list(re.finditer(pattern,text));assert starts and starts[0].start()==0
    rows=[text[m.start():(starts[i+1].start() if i+1<len(starts) else len(text))].removesuffix('\n') for i,m in enumerate(starts)]
    table={r.split('\t',1)[0]:r for r in rows};assert len(rows)==len(table)
    return table
env={k:v for k,v in os.environ.items() if not k.startswith(('TSR_','TSGO_','RAYON_'))};env['RAYON_NUM_THREADS']='4'
runs=[];tables={}
for mode in ('baseline','entry','candidate','contextual'):
    binary=next(r for r in triple['builds'] if r['mode']==mode)['outputs'][kind]
    exe=Path(binary['path']);assert sha(exe.read_bytes())==binary['sha256']
    command=['rtk','proxy',str(exe)];start=time.monotonic()
    if mode == 'contextual':
        with (root/(mode+'-'+suffix+'.tsv')).open('wb') as out,(root/(mode+'-'+suffix+'.stderr')).open('wb') as err:
            p=subprocess.Popen(command,cwd=root/'source',env=env,stdout=out,stderr=err)
            print(json.dumps({'mode':mode,'kind':suffix,'pid':(p.pid if mode=='contextual' else old['pid']),'command':command}),flush=True);rc=p.wait(timeout=600)
    else:
        prior=json.loads((root/(suffix+'-corpus.json')).read_text())
        old=next(r for r in prior['runs'] if r['mode']==mode)
        assert sha((root/(mode+'-'+suffix+'.tsv')).read_bytes())==old['stdout_sha256']
        assert binary['sha256']==old['binary_sha256'];rc=old['returncode']
    raw=(root/(mode+'-'+suffix+'.tsv')).read_bytes();table=parsed(raw)
    run={'mode':mode,'command':command,'pid':(p.pid if mode=='contextual' else old['pid']),'returncode':rc,'elapsed_seconds':(time.monotonic()-start if mode=='contextual' else old['elapsed_seconds']),'stdout_sha256':sha(raw),'binary_sha256':binary['sha256'],'row_count':len(table),'verdict_counts':dict(collections.Counter(r.split('\t',2)[1] for r in table.values())),'stderr':(root/(mode+'-'+suffix+'.stderr')).read_text()}
    runs.append(run);tables[mode]=table
    (root/(suffix+'-contextual-corpus-progress.json')).write_text(json.dumps({'runs':runs,'unfiltered':True,'threads':4},indent=2)+'\n')
    assert rc==0
    if not diagnostic:
        total=re.search(r'TOTAL (\d+)',run['stderr']);assert total and int(total.group(1))==len(table)
    print(json.dumps({k:run[k] for k in ('mode','returncode','row_count','verdict_counts')}),flush=True)
comparisons={}
for before_mode,after_mode in (('baseline','contextual'),('candidate','contextual'),('entry','contextual')):
    before,after=tables[before_mode],tables[after_mode];assert before.keys()==after.keys()
    if diagnostic:assert all(before[k].split('\t',3)[2]==after[k].split('\t',3)[2] for k in before)
    changed=[{'key':k,'before':before[k],'after':after[k]} for k in before if before[k]!=after[k]]
    transitions=dict(collections.Counter(r['before'].split('\t',2)[1]+'->'+r['after'].split('\t',2)[1] for r in changed))
    passing={'RIGHT','EMPTY_RIGHT'} if diagnostic else {'RIGHT'}
    lost=[r for r in changed if r['before'].split('\t',2)[1] in passing and r['after'].split('\t',2)[1] not in passing]
    summary={'source_revision':triple['source_revision'],'unfiltered':True,'same_population':True,'row_count':len(before),'changed_rows':len(changed),'transitions':transitions,'previous_right_losses':len(lost),'loss_case_counts':dict(collections.Counter(r['key'] if diagnostic else r['key'].rsplit(':',2)[0] for r in lost))}
    comparisons[before_mode+'->'+after_mode]={'summary':summary,'changed_rows':changed}
record={'source_revision':triple['source_revision'],'native_revision':triple['native_revision'],'fixture_revision':triple['fixture_revision'],'runs':runs,'baseline_reused':True, 'reuse_guard':'Fresh 53826afe baseline/entry/admission streams and binaries checked byte-for-byte against immutable admission receipts; contextual candidate independently compiled from same archive','threads':4,'comparisons':comparisons,'qualification':'Unfiltered fidelity only; no CPU/RSS or comparable performed-work performance gate. Public runs may overlap.'}
(root/(suffix+'-contextual-corpus.json')).write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({k:v['summary'] for k,v in comparisons.items()}))

import hashlib,json,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
root=Path(Path('/tmp/tsr-this-admission-path').read_text().strip())
p=root/'source/crates/tsr-checker/src/contextual.rs'
original=p.read_text();sha=lambda b:hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
needle='self.publication_read(&symbol)'
assert original.count(needle)==1
assert json.loads((root/'binary-triple.json').read_text())['candidate_restored']
records=[]
try:
    for name,replacement in [('read-unmapped-contextual-target','self.get_type_of_symbol(property)')]:
        changed=original.replace(needle,replacement)
        p.write_text(changed)
        label='mutant-'+name
        command=['rtk','proxy','python3','/tmp/tsr-this-admission-run.py',label,'rtk','proxy','cargo','test','--release','-p','tsr-checker','--lib','contextual_inherited_callback_reads_published_member_type','--','--nocapture']
        result=subprocess.run(command,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=600)
        record=json.loads((root/(label+'.json')).read_text())
        semantic=record['returncode']==101 and 'native accepts the contextual callback' in record['stderr'] and 'could not compile' not in record['stderr']
        records.append({'name':name,'command':command,'mutated_source':changed,'run':record,'detected':semantic,'compiler_failure_counted':False})
        assert semantic,record['stderr']
        p.write_text(original)
        assert sha(p.read_bytes())==sha(original.encode())
        print(json.dumps({'mutation':name,'semantic_failure':True,'restored_sha256':sha(p.read_bytes())}),flush=True)
finally:
    p.write_text(original)
    assert sha(p.read_bytes())==sha(original.encode())
    (root/'contextual-mutations.json').write_text(json.dumps({'before_sha256':sha(original.encode()),'mutations':records,'restored_sha256':sha(p.read_bytes())},indent=2)+'\n')
command=['rtk','proxy','python3','/tmp/tsr-this-admission-run.py','restored-contextual-library','rtk','proxy','cargo','test','--release','-p','tsr-checker','--lib']
result=subprocess.run(command,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=600)
record=json.loads((root/'restored-contextual-library.json').read_text());assert record['returncode']==0
assert '200 passed; 0 failed; 0 ignored' in record['stdout']
print(json.dumps({'restored_library':200,'exact_final_member_source_sha256':sha(p.read_bytes())}))

import collections,hashlib,json,os,re,subprocess,sys,time
from pathlib import Path
root=Path(Path('/tmp/tsr-this-admission-path').read_text().strip())
triple=json.loads((root/'binary-triple.json').read_text())
diagnostic=sys.argv[1]=='diagnostics';kind='diagverdictdump' if diagnostic else 'verdictdump'
suffix='diagnostics' if diagnostic else 'types';sha=lambda b:hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
assert [r['mode'] for r in triple['builds']]==['candidate','entry','baseline']
def parsed(raw):
    text=raw.decode();pattern=r'(?m)^[^\t\r\n]+\t(?:RIGHT|WRONG|EMPTY_RIGHT|EMPTY_WRONG)\t' if diagnostic else r'(?m)^[^\t\r\n]+:\d+:\d+\t(?:RIGHT|GAP|WRONG)\t'
    starts=list(re.finditer(pattern,text));assert starts and starts[0].start()==0
    rows=[text[m.start():(starts[i+1].start() if i+1<len(starts) else len(text))].removesuffix('\n') for i,m in enumerate(starts)]
    table={r.split('\t',1)[0]:r for r in rows};assert len(rows)==len(table)
    return table
env={k:v for k,v in os.environ.items() if not k.startswith(('TSR_','TSGO_','RAYON_'))};env['RAYON_NUM_THREADS']='4'
runs=[];tables={}
for mode in ('baseline','entry','candidate'):
    binary=next(r for r in triple['builds'] if r['mode']==mode)['outputs'][kind]
    exe=Path(binary['path']);assert sha(exe.read_bytes())==binary['sha256']
    command=['rtk','proxy',str(exe)];start=time.monotonic()
    with (root/(mode+'-'+suffix+'.tsv')).open('wb') as out,(root/(mode+'-'+suffix+'.stderr')).open('wb') as err:
        p=subprocess.Popen(command,cwd=root/'source',env=env,stdout=out,stderr=err)
        print(json.dumps({'mode':mode,'kind':suffix,'pid':p.pid,'command':command}),flush=True);rc=p.wait(timeout=600)
    raw=(root/(mode+'-'+suffix+'.tsv')).read_bytes();table=parsed(raw)
    run={'mode':mode,'command':command,'pid':p.pid,'returncode':rc,'elapsed_seconds':time.monotonic()-start,'stdout_sha256':sha(raw),'binary_sha256':binary['sha256'],'row_count':len(table),'verdict_counts':dict(collections.Counter(r.split('\t',2)[1] for r in table.values())),'stderr':(root/(mode+'-'+suffix+'.stderr')).read_text()}
    runs.append(run);tables[mode]=table
    (root/(suffix+'-corpus-progress.json')).write_text(json.dumps({'runs':runs,'unfiltered':True,'threads':4},indent=2)+'\n')
    assert rc==0
    if not diagnostic:
        total=re.search(r'TOTAL (\d+)',run['stderr']);assert total and int(total.group(1))==len(table)
    print(json.dumps({k:run[k] for k in ('mode','returncode','row_count','verdict_counts')}),flush=True)
comparisons={}
for before_mode,after_mode in (('baseline','entry'),('baseline','candidate'),('entry','candidate')):
    before,after=tables[before_mode],tables[after_mode];assert before.keys()==after.keys()
    if diagnostic:assert all(before[k].split('\t',3)[2]==after[k].split('\t',3)[2] for k in before)
    changed=[{'key':k,'before':before[k],'after':after[k]} for k in before if before[k]!=after[k]]
    transitions=dict(collections.Counter(r['before'].split('\t',2)[1]+'->'+r['after'].split('\t',2)[1] for r in changed))
    passing={'RIGHT','EMPTY_RIGHT'} if diagnostic else {'RIGHT'}
    lost=[r for r in changed if r['before'].split('\t',2)[1] in passing and r['after'].split('\t',2)[1] not in passing]
    summary={'source_revision':triple['source_revision'],'unfiltered':True,'same_population':True,'row_count':len(before),'changed_rows':len(changed),'transitions':transitions,'previous_right_losses':len(lost),'loss_case_counts':dict(collections.Counter(r['key'] if diagnostic else r['key'].rsplit(':',2)[0] for r in lost))}
    comparisons[before_mode+'->'+after_mode]={'summary':summary,'changed_rows':changed}
record={'source_revision':triple['source_revision'],'native_revision':triple['native_revision'],'fixture_revision':triple['fixture_revision'],'runs':runs,'baseline_reused':False,'threads':4,'comparisons':comparisons,'qualification':'Unfiltered fidelity only; no CPU/RSS or comparable performed-work performance gate. Public runs may overlap.'}
(root/(suffix+'-corpus.json')).write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+'\n')

import hashlib

import time

root = Path(Path('/tmp/tsr-this-admission-path').read_text().strip())
source = root/'source'
label = sys.argv[1]

def hashes():
    result = {}
    for directory, dirs, files in os.walk(source):
        dirs[:] = [d for d in dirs if d not in ('target', '.git')]
        for name in sorted(files):
            if name.endswith('.rs'):
                p = Path(directory)/name
